text: The historical connectivity operation passes Silent, but the sender first attempts the NTLM cookie handshake. Success returns Continue so the request can retry; only a failed handshake reaches the Silent guard and returns Break before a password prompt. Silent therefore limits user prompting in this scoped implementation; it does not skip the required first handshake. The later fixed sender has moved to protocol_shared and uses a different error/realm flow, so the old explicit cookie path is historical evidence. No network or cookie test ran.
title: Historical EWS silent connectivity still performs the NTLM handshake
